Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about EcoFlow products, payments, delivery, and warranty in Kenya.

Yes. Batteriq is Kenya's officially appointed EcoFlow distributor. Every product we sell is 100% genuine, sourced directly from EcoFlow, and comes with the full official EcoFlow international warranty. As an authorised dealer, we also provide EcoFlow-certified after-sales support, spare parts, and warranty claim processing directly in Kenya.

Batteriq is based in Nairobi, Kenya. We serve customers across all 47 counties with nationwide courier delivery. For Nairobi customers, we offer same-day and next-day delivery options.

Batteriq stocks and sells Bluetti power stations in Kenya. For Bluetti-specific warranty and authorisation queries, please contact us directly and we will advise on the appropriate support channel.

Charging time depends on the model and charging method: • EcoFlow DELTA Pro: ~1.9 hours via AC wall charging (2900W input) • EcoFlow DELTA 2: ~1.3 hours via AC wall charging (1200W input) • EcoFlow RIVER 2: ~60 minutes via AC wall charging (360W input) • EcoFlow RIVER 3: ~60 minutes via AC wall charging Solar charging times vary depending on panel wattage and sunlight conditions. EcoFlow's X-Stream fast charging technology charges most models to 80% in under 1 hour.

Yes. All EcoFlow power stations support simultaneous charging and discharging — called "pass-through charging". You can power your devices while the unit is plugged in and charging. This is particularly useful as a UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply) for home offices and essential equipment.

EcoFlow power stations use LFP (Lithium Iron Phosphate) battery chemistry, which is rated for: • 3,500+ charge cycles to 80% capacity • This equates to approximately 10 years of daily use After 3,500 cycles, the battery retains at least 80% of its original capacity — it does not suddenly fail. LFP chemistry is also significantly safer and more stable than traditional lithium-ion batteries.

Yes. EcoFlow power stations are designed to be left plugged in continuously. The Battery Management System (BMS) automatically stops charging when the battery reaches 100% and manages optimal charging cycles to extend battery life. For long-term storage (more than 3 months), EcoFlow recommends storing the unit at 30–60% charge in a cool, dry location.

The EcoFlow DELTA Pro (3600Wh, 3600W AC output) can power: • Refrigerator (150W) — 15+ hours • Television (100W) — 24+ hours • Laptop (60W) — 40+ hours • LED lights (10W) — multiple days • CPAP machine — 4+ nights • Electric kettle (1500W) — multiple uses • Power tools (intermittent use) For appliances with motors (fridge, AC), always check the surge wattage. The DELTA Pro handles surges up to 7200W.

Yes. EcoFlow RIVER 3 series and DELTA 3 series feature a 10ms UPS switchover time — faster than most household UPS units. This means connected devices experience no interruption during a power outage. The EcoFlow RIVER 3 (UPS) is specifically designed for this use case with a 10ms response time, making it ideal for routers, NAS drives, CCTV systems, and sensitive electronics.

Yes. Several EcoFlow models support extra battery expansion: • DELTA Pro: expandable to 10.8kWh with extra batteries • DELTA 2: expandable to 2kWh with one extra battery • DELTA 2 Max: expandable to 4kWh • DELTA 3 / DELTA 3 Plus: expandable with dedicated extra batteries • RIVER 3 / RIVER 3 Plus: expandable with EB300/EB600 extra batteries All compatible extra batteries are available from Batteriq.

All EcoFlow portable solar panels (MC4 connector) are compatible with all EcoFlow power stations. The key consideration is total wattage: • RIVER 2 / RIVER 3: max 110W solar input • DELTA 2: max 500W solar input • DELTA 2 Max: max 1000W solar input • DELTA Pro: max 1600W solar input • DELTA Pro 3: max 2600W solar input You can chain multiple panels to reach the max input. All EcoFlow panels use the standard MC4 connector.

Kenya has excellent solar irradiance — Nairobi averages 5.5 peak sun hours per day. Expected daily output: • 100W panel: ~500Wh/day (0.5kWh) • 220W panel: ~1,100Wh/day (1.1kWh) • 400W panel: ~2,200Wh/day (2.2kWh) Actual output depends on panel angle, shading, temperature, and cloud cover. EcoFlow panels are rated at Standard Test Conditions (25°C, 1000W/m²).

Yes. EcoFlow portable solar panels carry an IP68 waterproof rating (except the 45W panel which is IP65). IP68 means complete protection against dust and submersion in water up to 1 metre for 30 minutes. This makes them suitable for use during light rain, outdoor camping, and marine environments. Do not use during heavy storms or lightning.

Yes, with conditions. EcoFlow power stations accept solar input via MC4 connectors. Third-party panels work if: • Voltage is within the accepted range (check your specific model's specs) • Current does not exceed the max input current • Total wattage does not exceed the max solar input For guaranteed compatibility and optimal MPPT charging performance, EcoFlow-branded panels are recommended.

M-Pesa payment on Batteriq is fully automated: 1. Add items to cart and proceed to checkout 2. Enter your details and select "Pay Now with M-Pesa" 3. Enter your M-Pesa phone number 4. Click "Pay" — you receive an STK Push prompt on your phone within seconds 5. Enter your M-Pesa PIN to confirm 6. Payment is instantly verified and your order is confirmed No need to manually input a transaction code or send a screenshot. The system verifies automatically.

Batteriq offers three payment options: 1. Pay Now (M-Pesa STK Push) — instant payment during checkout 2. Cash on Delivery — pay in cash when your order arrives 3. M-Pesa on Delivery — our delivery person triggers an M-Pesa prompt to your phone at the doorstep All payment methods are available for all products.

You can cancel or modify your order within 2 hours of placing it by contacting us on WhatsApp or calling us directly. After 2 hours, if the order has been dispatched, cancellation may not be possible. For M-Pesa payments that have already been processed, refunds are issued within 3–5 business days back to your M-Pesa account.

For Nairobi orders: • Orders placed before 12PM: same-day delivery in most cases • Orders placed after 12PM: next-day delivery • Weekends: delivery available Saturday, Sunday by arrangement Delivery within Nairobi typically takes 2–4 hours from dispatch. You will receive a WhatsApp message with tracking information when your order is dispatched.

Yes. We deliver nationwide across all 47 counties via trusted courier partners: • Major towns (Mombasa, Kisumu, Nakuru, Eldoret): 1–2 business days • Other counties: 2–5 business days Delivery fees are calculated at checkout based on your location and the weight/size of your order. Large items like the DELTA Pro require special handling.

After placing your order, you receive an order confirmation email with your order number. You can track your order at any time by visiting batteriq.com/track-order and entering your order number and email address. No account is required. You will also receive WhatsApp updates when your order is confirmed, dispatched, and out for delivery.

Batteriq honours the full official EcoFlow warranty: • Power Stations: 24 months (2 years) • Solar Panels: 24 months product warranty + 5-year power output guarantee (≥90% at year 5) • Extra Batteries: 24 months • Accessories & Cables: 24 months • Smart Generators: 24 months Warranty starts from the date of purchase from Batteriq.

To make a warranty claim: 1. Register your product at batteriq.com/support/warranty (do this at purchase) 2. Contact Batteriq directly via WhatsApp or email with: - Your warranty registration number - A description of the issue - Photos or video of the fault 3. Our technical team will assess the claim within 48 hours 4. If approved: repair, replacement, or refund as appropriate As the authorised Kenya distributor, all warranty claims are handled locally — you do not need to ship products internationally.

The warranty does not cover: • Physical damage from drops, impacts, or mishandling • Water damage beyond the stated IP rating • Damage from incorrect voltage or power surges • Normal wear and tear (scratches, cosmetic marks) • Damage from unauthorised modifications or repairs • Consumable parts (cables, connectors) after 12 months If your product is damaged due to a manufacturing defect, it is covered. If damaged due to misuse, it is not.

We strongly recommend registering your product at batteriq.com/support/warranty as it speeds up any future warranty claims significantly. However, proof of purchase (M-Pesa receipt or order confirmation email) is sufficient to make a warranty claim even without prior registration.
